author: CommanderBrent01
body: Hello, My IGN is CommanderBrent01. I was banned 8 months ago for kill aura by a staff member and i was to, be completely honest. But over time i've learned that hacking makes minecraft just not fun and bugs staff members and players. So i really want to be able to join avicus and continue to play with your amazing community and server! I loved nebula i wish i wasn't so dumb before. If i were able to retrace my steps i wouldn't have accepted the hack client by my friend. It's a good that 1.8 hacks dont exist so their will be way less hackers!I hope you can see the reason to unban me. Im sorry for my sins and thank you in advance. Sincerely,Brent

title: CommanderBrent01 Ban Appeal

replies.author: hcnem
replies.body:
Hello,

Because you have been banned for a significant amount of time and have no past infractions, I will appeal your ban. However, if you are banned again, your chances of being unbanned will decrease to a minimal, if not 0%.

Regards,
Rinn
Avicus Network Administrator
